retention: Append-only snapshot index. Historical evidence does not expire when freshness windows end. Corrections use a new snapshot, never an in-place replacement.
refresh: Manual reviewed ingestion; no automatic source refresh is configured.

dataContract.notIndependent: Dubai monthly and quarterly cells, all/segment/registration baskets and context/official facts overlap. These are not distinct transaction counts.
dataContract.predictionScope: Univariate area-level monthly research projections for apartment and villa registration segments. Multiple stored measures are not yet a validated multi-factor valuation model.
limitations: Dubai source is an independent DLD-derived CC BY 4.0 snapshot, not a direct government export.
Publisher annual-cohort outlier filters can use later observations. All backtests are retrospective stored-vintage experiments, never point-in-time investment performance.
Observed medians reflect changing property mix, not constant-quality appreciation.
No future monthly values, missing months, coordinates or unit prices are fabricated.
Abu Dhabi annual/half-year conflicts remain flagged, not reconciled by guessing.
10-year project completion outlook is separate from evidence-backed price predictions. This model only evaluates 3, 6 and 12 months.
Rent, infrastructure, rates and supply are not claimed as trained explanatory factors.
Historic coverage and licensed feeds are still incomplete for all seven emirates.

methods.purge: Every selection/calibration target precedes the next window training cutoff; no random split.
methods.baseline: No-change and seasonal naive, compared with damped drift. More complex model requires 5% selection improvement and no degradation versus no-change on the later test.
methods.interval: 80% nominal empirical band. Publish only if at least 6 of 8 later test outcomes fall inside; small correlated sample, not a coverage guarantee.

dubaiMethodology.price: Median of individual eligible sale amount / registered procedure area, not a mean of segment medians.
dubaiMethodology.quality: Publisher flags zero, positive price/area, valid dates and unique source area; stricter type/subtype consistency.
dubaiMethodology.allTypes: The All types price basket contains supported residential apartments, villas and source-classified townhouses. Commercial, hotel, land and whole-building references are separate because populations/area bases differ.
dubaiMethodology.change: Descriptive median change; changing mix is not constant-quality appreciation.
dubaiMethodology.missing: No observation, unresolved geography or fewer than 20 observations yields no shaded price.
dubaiMethodology.outlierWarning: Publisher annual-cohort flags may use later observations; not a point-in-time backtest.
dubaiMethodology.registration: Source registration category, not independently verified construction status.
dubaiMethodology.areaBasis: Registered procedure area. Land uses plot area; building and villa area must not be assumed to be internal usable floor area.

dubaiSourcePublication.independentUpstreamVerification: Four date/amount/registered-area observations corroborated against a public Property Finder view, not whole-file certification.
dubaiSourcePublication.crossSourceTotals: Vintages and classification differ; source totals kept separate.
